About our Manchester United news

Latest Manchester United news in a live news feed, including transfer rumours, team news, results, interviews, fixtures and all the latest updates on Man Utd.

Founded in 1878, Manchester United are an English professional football club based in Old Trafford, Greater Manchester, playing their home matches at Old Trafford. The club are considered one of the most successful and widely supported teams in world football, with their status built on decades of domestic and European success, including an unprecedented era of dominance under Sir Alex Ferguson, who managed the club from 1986 to 2013. Their major honours include a record 20 English league titles, 12 FA Cups and three UEFA Champions League triumphs, with their most recent UCL victory coming in 2008.

The club's traditional colours are red and white, and the side currently competes in the Premier League, the top division of English football.

NewsNow aims to be the world's most accurate and comprehensive Manchester United news aggregator, bringing you the latest Red Devils headlines from the best Man Utd sites and other key regional and national news sources. Whether it's the very latest transfer news from Old Trafford, quotes from a press conference, match previews and reports, or news about United's progress in the Premier League or Champions League, we've got it covered.
